## About
Noe Flores started working on cars after he came to San Francisco, and he and his wife Olga opened Avenue Body Shop together. Noe's brother Joel and their kids, Janai and Noe Jr, have joined the shop too. The idea that has stuck with us the longest is simple: everyone gets treated like family.
We fix dents, paint whole cars, replace windshields and straighten frames on domestic and international makes, from vintage cars to the commuter you need back on the road. You get straight advice, a clear picture of what's being done, and a car that comes back clean.
Our customers have given us a 4.8 rating across 201 Google reviews, and we'd like to earn yours too.

## Services
- Dent repair and repaint: Small dings or serious damage, we fix the dents and paint as much of the car as it needs, including full repaints.
- Computerized color matching paint: Our painters mix and weigh the tints themselves, with help from a computerized database, to match your car's color.
- Frame damage: After a serious accident, Noe will look at the frame damage and tell you honestly whether your car can be made right.
- Glass and windshield replacement: Broken or cracked glass replaced so you're safe on the road again.
- Insurance claim assistance: We know the claims process well and can point out details in your policy you might not know you're paying for.
- Detailed car cleaning: We clean your car inside and out so it comes back looking its best.

## FAQ
Q: Do estimates cost anything?
A: No. Estimates are free and take about 15 minutes on average. Bringing the car in lets us see the damage in person.

Q: Will you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies and can help you through the claim.

Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: Any domestic or international make and model, from vintage cars to daily commuters.

Q: My car can't be driven. Can you help?
A: Yes. We can help you coordinate a tow to the shop.
